title: Chess User Flyweight
instructions: In `config/model.py` complete `UserIntrinsicState` (name, age, gender, email, phone_number, photo) and `UserExtrinsicState` (colour, current_game_streak, intrinsic_state). In `config/registry.py` implement `FlyweightRegistryImpl` so it stores shared intrinsic states in a dict named `_flyweights`, keyed by email, and returns the same object back. Leave `ChessUser` and the `FlyweightRegistry` interface unchanged.

evidence.label: UserIntrinsicState holds exactly the shared fields
UserExtrinsicState holds the per-game fields plus a reference to the intrinsic state
The registry returns the very same flyweight object (identity)
Storage is a dict named _flyweights keyed by email
Adding the same email again replaces the entry
Each registry has its own storage
Many games share one intrinsic state and one photo
